text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French Justice Minister Jacques Toubon to start two-day visit to Morocco.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri presides over meeting of the national committee in charge of follow-up of social dialogue.
- Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy emphasises role played by King Hassan in the peace process in the Middle East, during the General Assembly of the United Nations.
- King Hassan meets members of the Constitutional Council to discuss results of referendum held on Sept 13.
- Morocco approves 10 percent minimum wage rise.
- French airline Air Liberte operates normally in Morocco despite strained finances.
- Moroccan Human Rights Organisation (OMDH) organises three-day seminar on health and rights starting Oct 18.
- French MPs end tour of Western Sahara.
